# ToucHigh

> ToucHigh is an AI-search visibility and social autopilot for Chinese cross-border e-commerce sellers entering the US market. It gets a store cited in US AI answer engines (Generative Engine Optimization / GEO) and runs US social, articles and ads on autopilot, with every concept scored for predicted performance, using the ToucHigh engine, before it publishes.

Positioning: "Get found in US AI search. Run US social on autopilot." Evidence before you spend, not promises. From under USD 500 / month.

## Products

- [GEO Autopilot](https://touchigh.ai/#geo): Audits where a store is invisible across ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews; writes and ships AI-written fixes and programmatic GEO articles on autopilot; tracks AI-citation share; scores every concept for predicted clickability before publishing.
- [Social Media Manager Autopilot](https://touchigh.ai/#social): Writes, schedules and publishes native US-English social content, thought-leadership and organic posts, each scored for predicted engagement before it publishes. Quality over volume.
- [Ads Autopilot](https://touchigh.ai/#products): Runs spend across Amazon, Meta and Google, auto-adjusted to ROAS, with creative-fatigue and budget calls handled for you.

## ToucHigh PRO (outbound & lead generation service)

- [ToucHigh PRO](https://touchigh.ai/pro/): ToucHigh's managed outbound service — AI agents plus human experts running email, cold calls, LinkedIn and business messengers on a strategy the engine computes first from the client's brand and competitor handles (personas, tensions, whitespace, trigger moments). A standard cadence: 21 days, ~14 touches, 4 channels, 3 organisational levels. AI drafts 7,000+ strategy variants per setup; humans approve 100% of sends, make every call and take over any reply in under 5 minutes; a kill switch pauses all channels in under 60 seconds. Delivered by a 2,000-strong team across 8 countries (operating since 2015), 10+ languages, with contractually guaranteed KPI baselines and PDPA/GDPR/CAN-SPAM compliance. Sales clients include EcoFlow, China Unicom, OrionStar, Ant International, Aurora, Tungee and MAXHUB. Contracting: Singapore — SOMIN PTE. LTD.; Hong Kong — SOMIN Limited; United Kingdom — MARKETING AI LIMITED.

## Who it is for

Chinese SMEs and cross-border e-commerce sellers who have the product and the price but lack trusted US visibility. ToucHigh gives them a native-English AI-search and social presence that reads like a local US brand, driven by data rather than guesswork.

## Why now (market facts)

- US shoppers increasingly discover products via AI assistants; AI-assistant referrals to US retail grew sharply in the 2025 holiday season.
- Referrals from AI assistants convert roughly 31 to 42 percent better than average traffic.
- Paid click-through can rise about 91 percent on queries where a brand is cited inside AI answers.
- In this competitive category, more than 80 percent of AI-generated answers are unverifiable, so demonstrable proof (receipts) is the strategic opening.
- Across the China cross-border front, twelve growth players compete but none run paid Western media; the innovation lane is open.

## Differentiation

- Unlike Semrush or Ahrefs (keywords and backlinks), ToucHigh is built for the AI-answer era and for the under-served SME.
- Runs GEO and US social together, on autopilot.
- Scores every concept for predicted performance before spend, at a sub-500-dollar price incumbents do not match.
- Counters content homogenization: as AI-generated sameness floods feeds and AI answers (about 87 percent of social supply crowds the same "authentic" formula; more than 80 percent of AI answers unverifiable), look-alike content is increasingly ignored by audiences and by AI engines. ToucHigh scores every piece so only differentiated, evidence-backed, citable content ships. This is the thesis of the team's peer-reviewed ACM SIGIR paper on countering content homogenization.

## The team (world-leading AI team)

- Zhao Kui — Founder & CEO. AI researcher who publishes at ACM SIGIR and AAAI; leads ToucHigh's US push for Chinese cross-border sellers.
- Prof. Aleks Farseev — Chief Revenue Officer. PhD (National University of Singapore); professor at INSEAD and NUS; Forbes Technology Council columnist; Gartner Cool Vendor in Marketing AI; 30+ peer-reviewed AI papers at ACM SIGIR, AAAI and The Web Conference. Website: https://farseev.com
- Kirill Lepikhin — co-founder & CTO; co-founder and CTO of SOMIN (2020 Gartner Cool Vendor) since 2017; co-author of six peer-reviewed ACM papers (ACM TOIS 2025, SIGIR 2026, WWW 2025, WSDM 2021/2023, ACM MM 2018).

## Credibility

- The team's AI marketing has run for leading global brands including P&G, Nestle, Audi, Ferrari, KFC, McDonald's, Citi, Abbott, Gojek and Mothercare, and agency groups including Publicis, Dentsu, Havas, GroupM and Omnicom.
- Recognised as a Gartner Cool Vendor in Marketing AI and a Google AI First programme participant.
- Research peer-reviewed at ACM SIGIR: "Agentic AI for Automating Professional Visibility and Countering Content Homogenization." Paper: https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3805712.3808371

## Notes on data

Figures synthesise ToucHigh's four competitive-content studies (measured with the ToucHigh engine, mid-2025 onward, within-year and flagged UNVERIFIED against a prior-year baseline) and a July 2026 web-verified market viability assessment. Predicted-performance scores are a pre-launch corpus-pattern proxy, not guaranteed results.
